finding.text:
3 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15148 (Wilmerding) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Median sale price (County records): $48K (2020–2022) → $80K (2023–2025), +67%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Valid home sales (County records): 45 (2020–2022) → 30 (2023–2025), -33%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%. Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $65K (2020–2022) → $72K (2023–2025), +10%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

plain.headline: In ZIP 15148 (Wilmerding), sale prices climbed faster than across the county.

In ZIP 15148 (Wilmerding), home sales went from 45 (2020–2022) to 30 (2023–2025). The typical change across Allegheny County was +4%.
In ZIP 15148 (Wilmerding), home values (Zillow estimate) went from $65K (2020–2022) to $72K (2023–2025). The typical change across Allegheny County was +14%.
plain.confidence: Medium — treat this as a lead rather than a conclusion.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
3 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15104 (Braddock) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Median sale price (County records): $48K (2020–2022) → $80K (2023–2025), +67%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $56K (2020–2022) → $59K (2023–2025), +6%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Valid home sales (County records): 69 (2020–2022) → 57 (2023–2025), -17%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
2 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15214 (Pittsburgh) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): $1,161/mo (Aug 2023) → $1,515/mo (Aug 2026), +30%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Median sale price (County records): $165K (2020–2022) → $226K (2023–2025), +37%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
3 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15145 (Turtle Creek) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Valid home sales (County records): 128 (2020–2022) → 95 (2023–2025), -26%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%. Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $101K (2020–2022) → $107K (2023–2025), +6%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Median sale price (County records): $92K (2020–2022) → $125K (2023–2025), +36%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
2 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15126 (Imperial) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Median sale price (County records): $213K (2020–2022) → $307K (2023–2025), +44%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Valid home sales (County records): 238 (2020–2022) → 191 (2023–2025), -20%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
3 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15203 (Pittsburgh) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $223K (2020–2022) → $233K (2023–2025), +4%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): $1,687/mo (Aug 2023) → $1,820/mo (Aug 2026), +8%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Median sale price (County records): $250K (2020–2022) → $280K (2023–2025), +12%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

In ZIP 15203 (Pittsburgh), the typical sale price went from $250K (2020–2022) to $280K (2023–2025). The typical change across Allegheny County was +19%.

finding.text:
2 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15014 (Brackenridge) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Median sale price (County records): $94K (2020–2022) → $134K (2023–2025), +43%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $96K (2020–2022) → $106K (2023–2025), +10%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
4 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15232 (Pittsburgh) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $440K (2020–2022) → $478K (2023–2025), +9%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Median sale price (County records): $430K (2020–2022) → $575K (2023–2025), +34%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): $1,451/mo (Aug 2023) → $1,578/mo (Aug 2026), +9%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

In ZIP 15232 (Pittsburgh), asking rents went from $1,451/mo (Aug 2023) to $1,578/mo (Aug 2026). The typical change across Allegheny County was +14%.

finding.text:
2 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15035 (East Mc Keesport) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $97K (2020–2022) → $119K (2023–2025), +22%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Valid home sales (County records): 49 (2020–2022) → 42 (2023–2025), -14%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.

County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
2 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15211 (Pittsburgh) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Median sale price (County records): $256K (2020–2022) → $275K (2023–2025), +7%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%. Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $209K (2020–2022) → $227K (2023–2025), +8%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
2 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15137 (North Versailles) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $113K (2020–2022) → $135K (2023–2025), +19%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%. Median sale price (County records): $115K (2020–2022) → $148K (2023–2025), +29%; typical for Allegheny County: +19%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
1 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15209 (Pittsburgh) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Valid home sales (County records): 238 (2020–2022) → 296 (2023–2025), +24%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
1 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15116 (Glenshaw) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Valid home sales (County records): 326 (2020–2022) → 414 (2023–2025), +27%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

1 of 2 measured market indicators in ZIP 15056 (Leetsdale) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Home value index (Zillow ZHVI): $137K (2020–2022) → $150K (2023–2025), +10%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.

finding.text:
1 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15205 (Crafton) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): $1,290/mo (Aug 2023) → $1,401/mo (Aug 2026), +9%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
1 of 3 measured market indicators in ZIP 15057 (McDonald) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Valid home sales (County records): 243 (2020–2022) → 214 (2023–2025), -12%; typical for Allegheny County: +4%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

plain.headline: In ZIP 15057 (McDonald), home sales fell more than across the county.
bullets: In ZIP 15057 (McDonald), home sales went from 243 (2020–2022) to 214 (2023–2025). The typical change across Allegheny County was +4%.
plain.confidence: High — Zillow and County sales records agree.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15046 (Crescent) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
1 of 4 measured market indicators in ZIP 15108 (Coraopolis) moved noticeably differently from the typical Allegheny County ZIP.

Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): $1,382/mo (Aug 2023) → $1,518/mo (Aug 2026), +10%; typical for Allegheny County: +14%.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15216 (Pittsburgh) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

plain.headline: The housing market in ZIP 15216 (Pittsburgh) has moved much like the rest of Allegheny County.
plain.confidence: High — Zillow and County sales records agree.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15223 (Etna) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15228 (Pittsburgh) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15229 (Pittsburgh) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change. They differ on how large it was.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

plain.confidence: High — Zillow and County sales records agree.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15101 (Allison Park) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

plain.headline: The housing market in ZIP 15101 (Allison Park) has moved much like the rest of Allegheny County.
plain.confidence: High — Zillow and County sales records agree.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 15239 (Pittsburgh) broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

Zillow's home value index and County sale prices agree on the direction of price change.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
ZIP codes are mail-delivery areas; they do not match neighborhood or municipal boundaries. ZIP areas here are built from 2010 Census blocks and include only the Allegheny County part.
Zillow rents are asking rents for listed homes, not rents paid by current tenants. Rent changes cover Aug 2023 → Aug 2026, a different window from the other indicators.
County sales use only transfers coded 'VALID SALE'. Coding practice changed in 2020, so earlier years are not used.
The sales file has no property-type field, so medians can include non-residential sales.
No income, population, household or vacancy-rate data is loaded, so affordability for residents cannot be assessed.
Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI): UNKNOWN — not enough data.

plain.confidence: High — Zillow and County sales records agree.
keep_in_mind: ZIP codes don't line up with neighborhood borders.
Rents are asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Unusual doesn't mean good or bad — it means different from the rest of the county.

finding.text:
The housing market in ZIP 16059 broadly tracked the rest of Allegheny County.

The available evidence does not establish why these changes happened or who was affected: no income, population or tenure data is loaded, and ZIP codes do not match neighborhood boundaries.

limitations: No dataset in this analysis establishes causal relationships.
